arguments.command:
cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('/workspace/examples.json'))
open('/tmp/req.json','w').write(json.dumps(d[0]['request'],separators=(',',':')))
open('/tmp/req2.json','w').write(d[1]['raw'])
" && SYNECDOCHE_SITE=/workspace/site LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/site python3 /workspace/submission/run.py < /tmp/req.json > /tmp/out.json; echo "rc=$?"; python3 -c "
import json
got=json.load(open('/tmp/out.json'))
exp=json.load(open('/workspace/examples.json'))[0]['response']
print('MATCH' if got==exp else 'MISMATCH')
if got!=exp:
    import difflib
    a=json.dumps(got,indent=1,sort_keys=True).splitlines()
    b=json.dumps(exp,indent=1,sort_keys=True).splitlines()
    print('\n'.join(list(difflib.unified_diff(b,a,'exp','got'))[:80]))
"; echo "--- dup key case ---"; SYNECDOCHE_SITE=/workspace/site LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/site python3 /workspace/submission/run.py < /tmp/req2.json
